liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Cryptical Envelopment** (7 reviews): Reviewer thinks this was the final Cryptical of the 1985 revival; Opens the second set and is judged the tightest, hottest version of the Cryptical sandwich [21][22][24][25][26][30][31]
- **Nobody's Fault But Mine** (2 reviews): Singled out as a nice version, alongside the Eyes Of The World; A rare choice emerging from Space, seemingly Garcia's gesture after the tension [22][28]
- **Big Railroad Blues** (1 review): Garcia is said to flub lyrics here [25]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Reviewer says it rushes along at a very fast pace and is over too soon [26]
- **Don't Need Love** (1 review): Garcia left the stage during it while looking for the drummers, causing tension [28]

## Setlist highlights

- **Nobody's Fault But Mine**: back after 160 archived shows (861 days) [32]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-09-03.sbd.miller.34772.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 131 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd85-09-03.oade-schoeps.sacks.27250.sbeok.flacf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 136 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd85-09-03.sbd.keith.7229.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 131 min; rated 3.71/5 by 17 [3]. Said about its sound: Soundboard transfer sounds very clean and clear; Tape flip between Music Never Stopped and Don't Ease Me In is nearly seamless; both tracks need channels swapped; The splice from Space into Nobody's Fault But Mine is rougher and more noticeable [20][21]
- **gd1985-09-03.mtx.seamons.94595.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 131 min; rated 3/5 by 5 [4]
- **gd1985-09-03.169186.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 134 min [5]
- **gd85-09-03.oade.sacks.7691.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 132 min; rated 3.94/5 by 16 [7]. Said about its sound: Audience recording described as having good sound [25]
- **gd1985-09-03.Senn421.Darby.119571.Flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 127 min [8]

## Around the show

- Attendee on the way to Red Rocks says tension rose when Garcia walked off during Brent's song [28]
- Reviewer prefers this Cryptical > Other One > Cryptical over the 6/16 Greek Theatre one; first set is typical for 1985 [22]
- Reviewer says the best Cryptical > Other One > Cryptical came in 1969, and mentions the Greek revival [26]
- First set is called classic 1985, while the second set has weaker Garcia vocals despite great song choices [29]
- Reviewer attended the Greek Theatre return of Cryptical and recalls frenzied energy, with Garcia playing very hard in the Other One [31]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-09-03.sbd.miller.34772.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [1]
- **gd85-09-03.oade-schoeps.sacks.27250.sbeok.flacf**: source: flac16 Oade Master -- 90 X-Y Schoeps CMC441 & 10 ft spaced Schoeps CMC42s -> custom M118 x2 -> custom Oade mixer -> Oade MOD PCM-F1 @ first row behind board [2]. Also: Transfer went from master PCM through a DAW to WAV, then FLAC [2]
- **gd85-09-03.sbd.keith.7229.sbeok.shnf**: source: EAC> Shn by Jim Keith [3]
- **gd1985-09-03.mtx.seamons.94595.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [4]. Also: Matrix by Hunter Seamons combining the Keith soundboard transfer with the Oade audience master, using Final Cut Pro; Oade audience tape reached the matrix via Doug Oade's CDR, with no digital processing noted [4]
- **gd1985-09-03.169186.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell XLII-S90) [5]
- **gd85-09-03.oade.sacks.7691.sbeok.shnf**: source: Oade Master -- 9-3-85 was 90 degree X-Y CMC441 + CMC42s (spaced 10') -> Oade mixer->Oade mod PCM-F1 first row behind board > ? (no digital processing… [7]
- **gd1985-09-03.Senn421.Darby.119571.Flac1644**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; Sennheiser MD421's (PAS/LOC Behind Soundboard/6 Feet High)> Sony TC-D5M,Tapes sony Metallic; Transfer Information:Tascam… [8]. Also: Audience recording made and shared by Darby, from his collection of master audience tapes [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1985-09-03 Starlight Theater, Kansas City, MO, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1985-09-03-starlight-theater-kansas-city-mo-usa/) [36]
